news_source.title: Welcome Le Chonk: Mistral Large 4 on Hugging Face
news_source.date_source: Official Hugging Face article dated October29,2026; UTC midnight is a conservative day anchor, not an asserted publication hour.
news_source.summary: Mistral Large4 is a new open-weight multimodal and multilingual mixture-of-experts model. It accepts text and images and produces text, supports a one-million-token context, and is distributed under a license with specific model-as-a-service limitations. The official article explains coding and defensive cybersecurity capabilities, architecture and supported inference tools.
